data.gender_notes: Columbano is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'columba', meaning 'dove'. In Christian tradition, Columbano is a name for those who are peaceful, pure, and dedicated to the faith. The name Columbano carries the meaning “Dove” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Columbano usually hope their child will grow to embody dove and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Columbano belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dove.”

in_hebrew.name: קולומבנו
in_hebrew.meaning: קולומבנו - שמו של קדוש נוצרי, מתורגמן ליונה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קולומבנו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית, מתורגמן ליונה, וקשור לקדוש נוצרי שחי במאה השישית. השם קולומבנו משויך לקדוש אירי שנודע במפעלי החסד והדת שלו, והוא נחשב לאחד מהקדושים החשובים ביותר בתולדות הנצרות הקלטית. השם עצמו נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'קולומבה' שפירושה יונה, ומסמל את רוח הקדושה ואת השלום.

in_greek.name: Κολουμβανός
in_greek.meaning: Κολουμβανός - όνομα χριστιανού αγίου, μεταφράζεται σε περιστέρι
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Κολουμβανός είναι χριστιανικό όνομα που προέχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Columbanus, που σημαίνει περιστέρι. Ο Άγιος Κολουμβανός ήταν Ιρλανδός μοναχός και ιερέας που έζησε τον 6ο αιώνα και ήταν γνωστός για τις ιεραποστολές του στην Ευρώπη. Το όνομά του συνδέεται με την πνευματική του σχέση με το θείο και την ειρήνη που συμβολίζει το περιστέρι.

in_latin.name: Columbano
in_latin.meaning: Columbano - Christian saint's name, translates to dove or pigeon
in_latin.long_meaning: Columbano is a Christian name derived from the Latin word 'columba,' meaning dove or pigeon. This name is associated with Saint Columbano, an Irish monk and priest who lived in the 6th century and was renowned for his missionary work throughout Europe. The name symbolizes the Holy Spirit and peace, reflecting the saint's devotion to his faith and his role in spreading Christianity.

in_english.name: Columbano
in_english.meaning: Columbano - a Christian saint's name meaning dove or pigeon
in_english.long_meaning: Columbano is a Christian name originating from the Latin 'columba,' meaning dove or pigeon. It is associated with Saint Columbano, an Irish monk and priest from the 6th century, celebrated for his missionary journeys across Europe. The name represents peace, spirituality, and devotion, reflecting the saint's significant contributions to Christian tradition and his embodiment of the Holy Spirit.

data.cultural_impact: The name Columbano has its roots in the Latin language and is associated with doves as a symbol of peace in Christian culture. Many saints, including Saint Columbanus, were given this name in recognition of their peace-making qualities and dedication to the teachings of Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: Columbano, meaning dove, is a symbol of the peaceful and gentle nature of God. In Christianity, the dove is an emblem of the Holy Spirit that descended upon Jesus at His Baptism. Therefore, a person named Columbano is reminded of the spiritual qualities of purity, peace, and dedication to the faith that are embodied in this biblical symbol.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Columbano: Dedicated to Columba, the Irish monk known for his penance and devotion to God, symbolizing humility, perseverance, and a strong connection to spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Born in Italy around 543 AD, Columbano was an Italian monk and bishop who is considered the founder of the Benedictine monastic order.
